BROADCAST_MESSAGES.EMPTY: No scheduled broadcasts yet. Create one for birthdays, special dates, promotions or notices.
BROADCAST_MESSAGES.FETCH_ERROR: Could not load the scheduled broadcasts
BROADCAST_MESSAGES.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: The schedule stops running. Conversations already sent are kept.
BROADCAST_MESSAGES.QUEUED: Sending to {count} contacts. Messages go out one by one.

KINDS.ONCE: Once, on a date and time
KINDS.YEARLY_FIXED: Every year, on a fixed date
KINDS.YEARLY_WEEKDAY: Every year, on a movable date (e.g. 2nd Sunday of May)

SUMMARY.BIRTHDAY: Every day at {time} to contacts having a birthday

FORM.DESCRIPTION_SEND: The message goes now to the {count} contacts of this list. Each contact gets a new conversation sent by Chip.
FORM.NAME: Schedule name
FORM.BIRTHDAY_HINT: Uses the contact attribute "Birth date" (filled from the ERP).
FORM.NAME_FALLBACK: Text when there is no name
FORM.NAME_FALLBACK_HINT: Used instead of the first name for companies (attribute "Company") and contacts without a name.
FORM.TEAM_HINT: When the contact answers, the conversation stays locked until a technician takes it.
FORM.RESOLVE_AFTER_HOURS_HINT: If the contact does not answer in this time, the conversation is resolved without a closing message.
FORM.SEND_EMAIL: Also send by e-mail to contacts that have one
FORM.SUBJECT: E-mail subject
